movies.title: Heartland
movies.overview: Former country star Misty Jones leaves seclusion to search for her missing niece, an emerging musician, in Nashville. Her investigation exposes dark secrets and forces her to face her own past.

movies.title: Other Mommy
movies.overview: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity which comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces veteran James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

movies.title: Model Citizen
movies.overview: With his memories gone and his past a blur, ex-cop Steven Bay seeks treatment for his amnesia while working on an isolated farm. Instead, he's met with rising hostility, strange surveillance, and instincts he can’t fully control. When the pressure becomes unbearable, Bay begins a desperate hunt for the truth behind his fractured reality.

movies.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
movies.overview: Follows Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, who embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children after his wife dies, confronting forces closing in and beliefs threatening to unravel.

movies.title: Primetime
movies.overview: Inspired by true events in 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare.

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.overview: A hapless courier is tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

movies.title: A Wicked Muse
movies.overview: A struggling novelist makes a deal with a demonic spirit promising to catapult his writing career to stardom.

movies.title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
movies.overview: After the 9/11 attacks, no one could agree what should be done with Ground Zero. And so New York did something really crazy. They asked the people to decide.

movies.title: The Stunt Driver
movies.overview: The film chronicles the daredevil stuntman Ken Carter's quest to execute a bold stunt of launching a rocket car across the St. Lawrence River from Canada to the United States in the 1970s, facing absurd challenges along the way.

movies.title: Nikola Tesla 19hz
movies.overview: Nikola Tesla-visionary, inventor, genius. The world remembers his groundbreaking discoveries, but few know the secret that consumed his final years: a relentless quest to reach the other side. Armed with his own invention-the crystal radio, now a staple of today's ghost hunters-Tesla pushed the boundaries between science and the supernatural. Did he succeed? Did he make contact? What if everything we thought we knew was just the beginning?

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.overview: Sisters Elinor and Marianne Dashwood must leave their Sussex estate to live with a distant relative, while facing both romantic and financial struggles.

movies.title: Verity
movies.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

movies.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movies.overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

movies.title: Wo De Lao Ban Wei He Na Yang
By Any Means
movies.overview: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.
movies.overviewEs: Una tensa sociedad entre un endurecido sicario de la mafia y un joven agente negro del FBI se ve forzada a una difícil alianza para rastrear a los responsables del asesinato de varios líderes de los derechos civiles; en el proceso, descubrirán una conspiración que pondrá a prueba los límites de la justicia, la lealtad y la supervivencia.

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.overview: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

movies.title: Masterplan
movies.overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.
movies.overviewEs: Un mágico unicornio naranja que canta retiene a su elenco como rehén en una dimensión surrealista de programa de televisión, mientras se vuelve cada vez más demente.

movies.title: Ninja Wars: Blackfox Vs Shogun's Ninja
movies.originalTitle: Ninja Wars: BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
movies.overview: Set in feudal Japan, the story follows Rikka Isurugi, a highly skilled ninja warrior who becomes entangled in a dangerous power struggle involving rival ninja clans and the ruling shogunate.

movies.title: Babel
movies.overview: Tragedy strikes a married couple on vacation in the Moroccan desert, which jump starts an interlocking story involving four different families.
movies.overviewEs: La tragedia golpea a un matrimonio que está de vacaciones en el desierto marroquí, lo que da inicio a una historia entrelazada que involucra a cuatro familias diferentes.

movies.title: The Incomer
movies.overview: On a remote Scottish Island, Isla and brother Sandy live a normal life hunting seabirds, chatting to mythic creatures and defending their isle from Incomers. Their world is overturned with the arrival of Daniel, a lonely and socially inept council worker. He's there to evacuate them to the mainland but Isla and Sandy won't budge.

movies.title: Knight of Darkness (The Dark Knight Egyptian version)
Practical Magic 2
movies.overview: A multi-generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

movies.title: Animals
movies.overview: When the son of an L.A. Mayoral Candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and exposing a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.
movies.overviewEs: Cuando secuestran a su hijo, un candidato a alcalde y su esposa buscan desesperadamente reunir dinero para el rescate, pero sus decisiones podrían destruirles la vida.

movies.title: V/H/S/Mixtape
movies.overview: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

movies.title: The Fix
movies.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life changing score.
movies.overviewEs: Un grupo de exoperadores de la CIA, marcados por las secuelas de la guerra en Afganistán y el abandono de su gobierno, decide embarcarse en una peligrosa e ilegal misión de rescate en Teherán. Mientras se adentran en territorio hostil, la desconfianza mutua y los fantasmas de su pasado amenazan con sabotear una operación donde la redención y la supervivencia son su única salida.

movies.title: Matchbox: The Movie
movies.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.overview: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. Together they tackle dangerous Mount Kwan in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 4,000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to survive.
movies.overviewEs: Tras sobrevivir a una experiencia extrema, un nuevo grupo de jóvenes se enfrenta a un desafío aún más peligroso en un entorno remoto en Tailandia. A cientos de metros de altura, sin escapatoria y con condiciones impredecibles, deberán luchar contra el miedo, el tiempo y sus propios límites para sobrevivir.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

movies.title: Unabomber
movies.overview: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

movies.title: Union County
movies.overview: Assigned to a county-mandated drug court program, Cody Parsons embarks on the tenuous journey toward recovery amidst the opioid epidemic in rural Ohio.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.overview: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.
movies.overviewEs: Luego de que los productos Acme le fallan demasiadas veces en su tenaz búsqueda del Correcaminos, Wile E. Coyote decide contratar a un abogado especializado en vallas publicitarias para demandar a Acme Corporation.

movies.title: The Deputy
movies.overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

movies.title: Super Troopers 3
movies.overview: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

movies.title: Undisputed 2: Last Man Standing
movies.overview: Heavyweight Champ George "Iceman" Chambers is sent to a Russian jail on trumped-up drug charges. In order to win his freedom he must fight against the jailhouse fighting champ Uri Boyka in a battle to the death. This time he is not fighting for a title, he is fighting for his life!

movies.title: Undisputed III: Redemption
movies.overview: Boyka is back. This time he is fighting in the first ever inter-prison tournament with one knee.

movies.title: Undisputed
movies.overview: Monroe Hutchens is the heavyweight champion of Sweetwater, a maximum security prison. He was convicted to a life sentence due to a passionate crime. Iceman Chambers is the heavyweight champion, who lost his title due to a rape conviction to ten years in Sweetwater. When these two giants collide in the same prison, they fight against each other disputing who is the real champion.

movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood
movies.overview: After a lifetime of violent crime, a gravely wounded Robin Hood (Hugh Jackman) is rescued by a mysterious woman and offered one last chance at salvation in this fresh retelling of the epic legend.
movies.overviewEs: Una cruda reinterpretación de la leyenda de Robin Hood donde un solitario marcado por la batalla, atormentado por su violento pasado, encuentra la redención a través de una mujer enigmática tras una grave herida.

movies.title: Portal to Hell
movies.overview: A routine debt collector's life is turned upside down when a portal to hell opens in his local laundromat followed by a demon who offers him a deal - three souls to save his neighbor from being dragged to hell.

movies.title: Colors
movies.overview: A confident young cop is shown the ropes by a veteran partner in the dangerous gang-controlled barrios of L.A. about to explode in violence in this look at the gang culture enforced by the colors that members wear.
movies.overviewEs: Bob Hodges es un policía experimentado que trata de enseñar a su joven pupilo Danny McGavin a sobrevivir patrullando en la zona este de L.A., donde impera la ley de las bandas callejeras.

movies.title: Moana
movies.overview: Leaving her island for the first time, young Moana embarks on an epic seafaring adventure to restore prosperity to her people. She is chosen by the ocean to return a stolen mystical heart to the goddess Te Fiti and stop a dark blight in world

movies.title: The Runner
movies.overview: A successful London-based attorney (GAL GADOT) is thrust into a tense and dangerous race across the city after her son, Noah (RORY WILMOT) is abducted. Forced to obey a series of cryptic commands from a mysterious Caller (DAMIAN LEWIS), she races against time through a web of secrets and threats in a desperate bid to save her son.

movies.title: Sweetheart
movies.overview: Jenn has washed ashore a small tropical island and it doesn’t take her long to realize she’s completely alone. She must spend her days not only surviving the elements, but must also fend off the malevolent force that comes out each night.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.overview: Lieutenant Troy Kelly takes part in a top secret surveillance mission over Soviet airspace. Things take a sharp turn, however, when he is forced to eject from his plane over the Russian wilderness. He is rescued by a paradoxical Russian native and the two begin to appreciate both their differences and commonalities.

movies.title: Enemy Mine
movies.overview: A soldier from Earth crashlands on an alien world after sustaining battle damage. Eventually he encounters another survivor, but from the enemy species he was fighting; they band together to survive on this hostile world. In the end the human finds himself caring for his enemy in a completely unexpected way.
movies.overviewEs: Enemigos por instinto, amigos por necesidad, un humano y un alienígena con aspecto de reptil libran en un planeta hostil una dura batalla, parte de la salvaje guerra que enfrenta a la tierra con el planeta Dracon, habitado por seres monstruosos. Esta guerra alcanza una dimensión que puede poner en peligro la supervivencia de ambos planetas y puede conducir al exterminio total, pero sólo forzados a confiar el uno en el otro conseguirán sobrevivir.

movies.title: Tunnel
movies.overview: A man is on his way home when the poorly constructed tunnel he is driving through collapses, leaving him trapped.

movies.title: Road House
movies.overview: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton takes a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys roadhouse, only to discover that this paradise is not all it seems.

movies.title: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
movies.overview: When diabolical genius Dr. Evil travels back in time to steal superspy Austin Powers's ‘mojo,’ Austin must return to the swingin' '60s himself - with the help of American agent, Felicity Shagwell - to stop the dastardly plan. Once there, Austin faces off against Dr. Evil's army of minions to try to save the world in his own unbelievably groovy way.
movies.overviewEs: Tras ser congelado, Austin Powers, un agente secreto de los años 60, vuelve a la vida en los años 90. Se encuentra con una nueva sociedad en la que tendrá que enfrentarse con nuevos villanos, pero también con el Doctor Maligno, su máximo enemigo. El malvado doctor tiene un siniestro plan: ha inventado una máquina del tiempo que le permitirá volver a los años 60 y destruir a su archienemigo. Pero Powers contará con la ayuda de una bella agente para derrotarlo.

movies.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
movies.overview: As a swinging fashion photographer by day and a groovy British superagent by night, Austin Powers is the '60s' most shagadelic spy. But can he stop megalomaniac Dr. Evil after the bald villain freezes himself and unthaws in the '90s? With the help of sexy sidekick Vanessa Kensington, he just might.
movies.overviewEs: Primera aventura de Austin Powers (Mike Myers), un peculiar y atractivo espía de los años sesenta, cuyo principal enemigo es el doctor Maligno (interpretado también por Myers). Tras ser ambos sometidos a un proceso de congelación, se despiertan treinta años después en una sociedad completamente distinta a la que conocían. Sin embargo, ellos siguen siendo los mismos.

movies.title: Bedazzled
movies.overview: Socially-awkward IT worker Elliot Richards is given seven wishes to get the girl of his dreams when he meets up with a very seductive Satan. The catch: his soul. Some of his wishes include being a 7-foot basketball star, a wealthy, powerful man, and a sensitive, caring guy. But, as could be expected, the Devil must put her own little twist on each his fantasies.
movies.overviewEs: Elliot Richardson (Brendan Fraser) es un joven torpe y bondadoso, con poco éxito en la vida, que vende su alma al diablo (una explosiva Elizabeth Hurley) a cambio de unos deseos que no se ven del todo cumplidos...como él hubiera deseado. Remake de la película homónima de 1967 escrita por Peter Cook.

movies.title: RE:BORN
movies.overview: A legend covert soldier with a mysterious past now decides to once again unleash his beast inside of him to stand up for what he cares about.

movies.title: The Whisper Man
movies.overview: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Garretton, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulate that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

movies.title: Motor City
movies.overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl. In retaliation, the gangster enacts a frame job to send the innocent man to prison. Life ruined, Miller plots a revenge campaign against the man who took his girl away.

movies.title: Symbol
movies.overview: A man wakes up in a white room empty other than buttons on the walls, he must find out which button to push to get what he wants.

movies.title: Firebrand
movies.overview: Katherine Parr, the sixth wife of King Henry VIII, is named regent while the tyrant battles abroad. When the king returns, increasingly ill and paranoid, Katherine finds herself fighting for her own survival.
movies.overviewEs: Una historia de terror psicológico ambientada en la sangrienta corte Tudor del infame rey Enrique VIII de Inglaterra (Jude Law). Contada desde el punto de vista de la reina Catalina Parr (Alicia Vikander), la sexta y última esposa de Enrique y la única que evitó el destierro o la muerte.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.overview: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.
movies.overviewEs: Dos policías mexicanos, durante un control rutinario en las últimas horas de su turno, detienen un coche robado y se encuentran cara a cara con uno de los delincuentes más peligrosos del mundo.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom, leading to an endless network of interconnected rooms where time bends and the only thing scarier than getting lost is the sense that something is lying in wait.
movies.overviewEs: Una extraña puerta aparece en el sótano de una exposición de muebles. Cuando el paciente de una terapeuta desaparece en una dimensión más allá de la realidad, ella deberá adentrarse en lo desconocido para salvarlo.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
movies.originalTitle: 劇場版「鬼滅の刃」無限城編 第一章 猗窩座再来
movies.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.
movies.overviewEs: Tanjirō Kamado es un chico que se unió a una organización dedicada a cazar demonios después de que su hermana menor, Nezuko, fuera convertida. Mientras los miembros de la organización y los Pilares participaban en un programa de entrenamiento grupal, como preparación para la inminente batalla contra los demonios, Muzan Kibutsuji aparece en la Mansión Ubuyashiki. Con el jefe de la organización en peligro, Tanjirō y los Pilares corren hacia la mansión, pero son arrastrados a un espacio misterioso por obra de Kibutsuji. El lugar al que han caído Tanjirō y los cazadores es el bastión de los demonios: el Castillo Infinito. Así, el campo de batalla queda establecido para dar fin a la guerra entre humanos y demonios.

movies.title: Café de Flore
movies.overview: A love story between a man and woman. And between a mother and her son. A mystical and fantastical odyssey on love.
movies.overviewEs: Historias de amor y el destino, en Paris durante los años 1960 y Montreal en el 2010. En París, Jacqueline es la madre de un niño con síndrome de Down con quien mantiene una relación simbiótica la cual le impide enviarlo a una institución. Antoine, DJ en Montreal, no puede decir adiós a su amor de la infancia. Los dos comparten una historia que es oscura y a la vez luminosa, llena de esperanza.

movies.title: Seven Days
movies.overview: Like many happy people, Bruno Hamel is leading an uneventful life until one afternoon, when his daughter is raped and murdered. When the murderer is arrested, a terrible project germinates in Bruno's darkened mind. He plans to capture the "monster" and make him pay for his crime.

movies.title: Young Washington
movies.overview: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.overview: Joe and Angela’s (Seth Rogen & Olivia Wilde) marriage is on thin ice. When their upstairs neighbors visit for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.overview: Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, Jackass: Best and Last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you've come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.overview: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

movies.title: Soulm8te
movies.overview: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

movies.title: Leviticus
movies.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

movies.title: Lucky Strike
movies.overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.overview: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws in their secluded family home. As one by one they are transformed into Deadites—turning the gathering into a family reunion from hell—she comes to discover that the vows she took in life... live on even in death.
movies.overviewEs: Tras la muerte de su esposo, una mujer busca consuelo en sus suegros. A medida que uno a uno se transforman en muertos vivientes, descubre que los votos que hizo en vida perduran incluso en la muerte.

movies.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
movies.overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

movies.title: Supergirl
movies.overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.
movies.overviewEs: Si descubrieras que no estamos solos, si alguien te abriera los ojos y te lo demostrase, ¿te asustarías?

movies.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
movies.overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

movies.title: Scary Movie
movies.overview: Two friends find themselves caught up in mayhem involving killers, monsters and supernatural creatures once again.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.
movies.overviewEs: Sigue la lucha de Miranda Priestly contra Emily Charlton, su ex asistente convertida en ejecutiva rival, mientras compiten por los ingresos por publicidad en medio de la decadencia de los medios impresos y Miranda se acerca a la jubilación.

movies.title: Heal
movies.overview: A documentary film that takes us on a scientific and spiritual journey where we discover that by changing one's perceptions, the human body can heal itself from any dis-ease.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.overview: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

movies.title: The Sheep Detectives
movies.overview: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

movies.title: Deep Water
movies.overview: A group of international passengers en route from Los Angeles to Shanghai are forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. Now they must work together in hopes to overcome the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.
movies.overviewEs: Un grupo de pasajeros internacionales en ruta de Los Ángeles a Shanghai se ven obligados a realizar un aterrizaje de emergencia en aguas infestadas de tiburones. Ahora deben superar el frenesí de los tiburones merodeantes.

movies.title: Moonwalker
movies.overview: Anthology movie by, and starring, Michael Jackson in his prime, combining a number of music videos from his bestselling "Bad" album with a fantasy tale of Michael's confrontation with a ruthless drug dealer known as Mr. Big.

movies.title: Night Crossing
movies.overview: True tale about two men planning to escape from communist East Germany in a hot air balloon, but only if they can take their families with them.

movies.title: Harriet
movies.overview: The extraordinary tale of Harriet Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroines, whose courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.

movies.title: Seven Snipers
movies.overview: A retired sniper in hiding on an Australian ranch must reunite her elite kill squad when a vengeful warlord threatens her daughter.

movies.title: Michael
movies.overview: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

movies.title: In the Grey
movies.overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to steal it back--an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

movies.title: Hokum
movies.overview: When Ohm Bauman, a horror novelist, retreats to a remote Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance force him to confront the dark corners of his past.

movies.title: Protector
movies.overview: Former war hero Nikki's peaceful life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

movies.title: A Great Awakening
movies.overview: One of the most defining moments in American history is the story of an unlikely friendship between the Reverend George Whitefield and Benjamin Franklin.

movies.title: Don't Look Up
movies.overview: Two low-level astronomers must go on a giant media tour to warn humankind of an approaching comet that will destroy planet Earth.
movies.overviewEs: Dos astrónomos realizan una gira mediática para advertirle a la humanidad de un cometa mortal que está en rumbo de colisión con la Tierra. La respuesta del mundo: ¿Y?

movies.title: Charlatan
movies.overview: The life of successful Czech healer Jan Mikolasek, who diagnosed and healed people using his intuition and strong familiarity with plants, set against the background of the events of the totalitarian fifties.

movies.title: Mother Mary
movies.overview: Preparing a comeback, the reunion of pop icon (Anne Hathaway) and legendary stylist she betrayed (Michaela Coel) spirals into supernatural reckoning, in this psychosexual pop thriller with music from Charli xcx, Jack Antonoff, and FKA Twigs.

movies.title: The Code
movies.overview: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.
movies.overviewEs: Un ladrón del maestro recluta a un ladrón celebre para ayudarle a robar dos huevos de Faberge famosos de una bóveda impenetrable en un intento de llevar a cabo un trabajo final y reembolsar su deuda a la muchedumbre rusa.

movies.title: Fracture
movies.overview: A husband is on trial for the attempted murder of his wife, in what is seemingly an open/shut case for the ambitious district attorney trying to put him away. However, there are surprises for both around every corner, and, as a suspenseful game of cat-and-mouse is played out, each must manipulate and outwit the other.

movies.title: Normal
movies.overview: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

movies.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
movies.overview: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat II
movies.overview: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

movies.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
movies.overview: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
movies.overview: Frank is haunted by hallucinations of his dead squad mates and family. A vengeful mother seeking revenge against Frank for his killing her husband and sons puts out a bounty on his head that brings dozens of criminals out, all trying to kill Frank.

movies.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
movies.overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

movies.title: Faces of Death
movies.overview: Margot Romero, a content moderator haunted by a viral tragedy, must track down a sadistic filmmaker who recreates legendary snuff cinema to silence the internet's obsession with her own past trauma.
movies.overviewEs: Una moderadora de un sitio web similar a YouTube, cuyo trabajo es eliminar contenido ofensivo y violento y que se está recuperando de un trauma, descubre que hay un grupo recreando los asesinatos de una película antigua. En una historia ambientada en la era digital y de la desinformación en línea, surge la pregunta: ¿son los asesinatos reales o falsos?

movies.title: Big Brother
movies.overview: A soldier-turned-high school teacher uses unusual methods to reach to a class of poor students, while dealing with a greedy entrepreneur and his gang of fighters as well as the government.
movies.overviewEs: Un soldado convertido en profesor de secundaria utiliza métodos inusuales para llegar a una clase de estudiantes pobres, mientras trata con un empresario codicioso y su banda de combatientes, así como con el gobierno.

movies.title: Diabolik
movies.overview: The dark and romantic story of the first meeting between master thief Diabolik and Eva Kant, set in the fictional state of Clerville in the late 1960s. Inspector Ginko is on the hunt for the criminal, trying to stop his evil plans.
movies.overviewEs: Adaptación cinematográfica de las aventuras del personaje creado por Angela y Luciana Giussani en los años 60. Diabolik es un ladrón con miles de disfraces y con miles de trucos. Gracias a sus especiales máscaras de plástico, es como una especie de camaleón capaz de mimetizarse a su gusto y escapar de los adversarios hasta en situaciones muy peligrosas.

movies.title: Buffet Infinity
movies.overview: Echoing the Canadian comedy classic SCTV, crosscutting between original, low-budget TV ads to tell the sinister tale of two restaurants battling it out in the fictional town of Westridge County.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.overview: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

movies.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
movies.overview: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.overview: Tommy Riley has moved with his dad to Chicago from a 'nice place'. He keeps to himself, goes to school. However, after a street fight he is noticed and quickly falls into the world of illegal underground boxing - where punches can kill.

movies.title: Wuthering Heights
movies.overview: A forbidden relationship unfolds between Cathy and Heathcliff, which develops from quiet longing to a dangerous pull of intense attraction, passion and increasing turmoil. Cathy and Heathcliff are at the center of a dramatically escalating relationship whose emotional course is getting further and further out of control.

movies.title: Porco Rosso
movies.overview: In Italy in the 1930s, sky pirates in biplanes terrorize wealthy cruise ships as they sail the Adriatic Sea. The only pilot brave enough to stop the scourge is the mysterious Porco Rosso, a former World War I flying ace who was somehow turned into a pig during the war. As he prepares to battle the pirate crew's American ace, Porco Rosso enlists the help of spunky girl mechanic Fio Piccolo and his longtime friend Madame Gina.

movies.title: Whisper of the Heart
movies.overview: Shizuku lives a simple life, dominated by her love for stories and writing. One day she notices that all the library books she has have been previously checked out by the same person: "Seiji Amasawa."

movies.title: The Wind Rises
movies.overview: Jiro Horikoshi studies assiduously to fulfill his aim of becoming an aeronautical engineer. As WWII begins, fighter aircraft designed by him end up getting used by the Japanese Empire against its foes.

movies.title: When Marnie Was There
movies.overview: Anna, a shy 12-year-old girl, is sent to spend time with her aunt and uncle who live in the countryside, where she meets Marnie. The two become best friends. But Anna gradually discovers that Marnie is not quite who she appears to be.

movies.title: The Boy and the Heron
movies.originalTitle: 君たちはどう生きるか
movies.overview: While the Second World War rages, the teenage Mahito, haunted by his mother's tragic death, is relocated from Tokyo to the serene rural home of his new stepmother Natsuko, a woman who bears a striking resemblance to the boy's mother.  As he tries to adjust, this strange new world grows even stranger following the appearance of a persistent gray heron, who perplexes and bedevils Mahito, dubbing him the "long-awaited one."
movies.overviewEs: Mientras la Segunda Guerra Mundial hace estragos, el adolescente Mahito, atormentado por la trágica muerte de su madre, es trasladado de Tokio a la serena casa rural de su nueva madrastra Natsuko, una mujer que tiene un sorprendente parecido con la madre del niño. Mientras intenta adaptarse, este nuevo y extraño mundo se vuelve aún más extraño tras la aparición de una persistente garza real, que deja perplejo y atormenta a Mahito, llamándolo "el tan esperado".

movies.title: The Red Turtle
movies.overview: A man is shipwrecked on a deserted island and encounters a big red turtle, which changes his life.

movies.title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
movies.overview: Kaguya is a beautiful young woman coveted by five nobles. To try to avoid marrying a stranger she doesn't love, she sends her suitors on seemingly impossible tasks. But she will have to face her fate and punishment for her choices.

movies.title: Ponyo
movies.overview: When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a powerful sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea.

movies.title: Tales from Earthsea
movies.overview: As crops dwindle and dragons reappear, mankind stands on the verge of total chaos. Lord Archmage Sparrowhawk, a powerful wizard, and Arren, a troubled young prince, search for the force behind this mysterious imbalance that threatens to destroy the land of Earthsea.

movies.title: My Neighbors the Yamadas
movies.originalTitle: ホーホケキョ となりの山田くん
movies.overview: The Yamadas are a typical middle class Japanese family in urban Tokyo and this film shows us a variety of episodes of their lives. With tales that range from the humourous to the heartbreaking, we see this family cope with life's little conflicts, problems and joys in their own way.

movies.title: Pom Poko
movies.overview: As the human city development encroaches on the raccoon dog population's forest and meadow habitat, the raccoon dogs find themselves faced with the very real possibility of extinction. In response, the raccoon dogs engage in a desperate struggle to stop the construction and preserve their home.

movies.title: From Up on Poppy Hill
movies.overview: A group of Yokohama students fight to save their school's clubhouse from the wrecking ball during preparations for the 1964 Tokyo Olympic Games. While working there, Umi and Shun gradually attract each other, but face a sudden trial. Even so, they keep going without fleeing the difficulties of reality.

movies.title: Earwig and the Witch
movies.overview: Growing up in an orphanage in the British countryside, Earwig has no idea that her mother had magical powers. Her life changes dramatically when a strange couple takes her in, and she is forced to live with a selfish witch. As the headstrong young girl sets out to uncover the secrets of her new guardians, she discovers a world of spells and potions, and a mysterious song that may be the key to finding the family she has always wanted.
movies.overviewEs: Earwig tiene diez años, vive en el orfanato San Morwald y no quiere marcharse de allí. Para ahuyentar a posibles padres adoptivos, utiliza sus poderes mágicos. Sin embargo, un día aparecerán Bella Yaga y Mandrágora, dos extraños y espeluznantes personajes que conseguirán adoptarla. La joven Earwig descubrirá que Bella Yaga es una poderosa bruja y se convertirá en su aprendiz.

movies.title: Arrietty
movies.originalTitle: 借りぐらしのアリエッティ
movies.overview: The Clock family consists of three four-inch-tall people who live incognito among humans, borrowing only what they need to survive. Their quiet life changes when their teenage daughter, Arrietty, is discovered.
movies.overviewEs: En una casita oculta bajo las tablas del suelo de una mansión campestre, vive una familia de seres diminutos, de apenas 10 cm. de altura, que tienen la norma de no dejarse ver nunca por los seres humanos; sin embargo, su tranquila existencia cambia cuando Arrietty, una audaz adolescente, es vista accidentalmente por un niño que se acaba de establecer en la casa debido a su delicada salud. Al tiempo que entre ambos surge una gran amistad, la existencia de los diminutos seres se verá peligrosamente amenazada... Adaptación del cuento infantil "The Borrowers", escrito por Mary Norton y ambientado en el Tokio contemporáneo.

movies.title: The Cat Returns
movies.overview: After helping a cat, a seventeen-year-old girl finds herself involuntarily engaged to a cat Prince in a magical world where her only hope of freedom lies with a dapper cat statuette come to life.
movies.overviewEs: Esta es la historia de Haru, una joven cuya suerte cambiará un día al volver del instituto, cuando salvará a un gato de ser atropellado por un camión. Pero no es un gato común, es Lune, el Príncipe del Reino de los Gatos. En recompensa por su acción, Haru será invitada a pasar un tiempo en el Reino de los Gatos, aunque no es lo que ella esperaba....

movies.title: Ocean Waves
movies.overview: The main character travels to his hometown for his high school reunion. During the trip, he recalls the memories of the days in high school. Friendship, subtle love, a trip to Tokyo and so on all came back to him as the film evolves.

movies.title: Only Yesterday
movies.overview: A twenty-seven-year-old office worker travels to the countryside while reminiscing about her childhood in Tokyo.

movies.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
movies.overview: Along with her black cat Jiji, Kiki settles in a seaside town and starts a high-flying delivery service. Here begins her magical encounter with independence and responsibility, making lifelong friends and finding her place in the world.

movies.title: My Neighbor Totoro
movies.overview: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

movies.title: Grave of the Fireflies
movies.overview: The story of Seita and Setsuko, two young Japanese siblings, living in the declining days of World War II. When an American firebombing separates the two children from their parents, the two siblings must rely completely on one another while they struggle to fight for their survival.

movies.title: The Housemaid
movies.overview: Millie, a struggling young woman, becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple, Nina and Andrew. She enters a mansion of secrets, manipulation, and escalating psychological games that pull her into a dangerous relationship dynamic.

movies.title: Money Talks
movies.overview: Chris Tucker is a small time con man who instantly becomes famous after a murder, wanted dead or alive, his only hope is a journalist named James Russell (Sheen).

movies.title: The Drama
movies.overview: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple (Zendaya and Robert Pattinson) off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."
movies.overviewEs: Cuenta la historia de una pareja cuyo romance cambia radicalmente antes de su gran día.

movies.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
movies.overview: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

movies.title: Apex
movies.overview: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.
movies.overviewEs: Una mujer en duelo que busca poner a prueba sus límites en la naturaleza australiana queda atrapada en un retorcido juego mortal con un asesino que la considera su presa.

movies.title: They Will Kill You
movies.overview: A woman answers a help wanted ad to be a housekeeper in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that she is entering a community that has seen a number of disappearances over the years and may be under the grip of a Satanic cult.

movies.title: The Whistler
movies.overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

movies.title: Ballistic
movies.overview: A mother who works for an ammunition manufacturing company finds out she made the bullet that killed her son.
movies.overviewEs: Una madre desconsolada que trabaja en una fábrica de municiones descubre que la bala que mató a su hijo en Afganistán fue fabricada en su propia línea de montaje. Decidida a encontrar respuestas, se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda de la verdad que la llevará a enfrentarse a la misma industria para la que trabaja y a los secretos detrás de la muerte de su hijo.

movies.title: Thrash
movies.overview: When a Category 5 hurricane decimates a coastal town, the storm surge brings devastation, chaos and something far more frightening: hungry sharks.

movies.title: The Yeti
movies.overview: Merriell Sunday Sr. and Hollis Bannister vanished in Alaska. Ellie and Merriell Jr. mount a search, but an ancient threat stalks their expedition into the wilderness, hunting them as they seek the truth behind the disappearances.

movies.title: War Machine
movies.overview: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

movies.title: The Bride!
movies.overview: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. What ensues is beyond what either of them imagined, igniting a combustible romance, the attention of the police and a wild and radical cultural movement.
movies.overviewEs: Un solitario Frankenstein viaja al Chicago de los años 30 para pedirle al científico pionero Dr. Euphronious que le cree una compañera. Ambos reviven a una joven asesinada y nace La Novia. Pero lo que sigue supera lo que ninguno de los dos imaginó.

movies.title: Judas' Gospel
movies.overview: On the same day, two men die hanging from a log a few steps away: Jesus on the cross, Judas on a tree. They are mirror images: one needs the other for destiny to be fulfilled. The facts narrated by the evangelists are told by Judas.

movies.title: Crime 101
movies.overview: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.
movies.overviewEs: Un escurridizo ladrón ve la oportunidad de hacer el golpe de su vida con la esperanza de que sea su último trabajo. En su camino se cruza con una desilusionada corredora de seguros y también un implacable detective se acerca a la operación, lo que aumenta aún más lo que está en juego . A medida que se acerca el robo multimillonario, la línea entre cazador y presa comienza a difuminarse, y los tres se ven obligados a afrontar el coste de sus decisiones y darse cuenta de que no hay vuelta atrás.

movies.title: Primer
movies.overview: A group of fledgling inventors discover a complex method to manipulate reality. At first, they successfully game the stock market with it, but the consequences of the invention start to catch up with them.

movies.title: Send Help
movies.overview: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

movies.title: How to Make a Killing
movies.overview: Disowned by his obscenely wealthy family, Becket Redfellow (Glen Powell) will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way in this irreverent thriller about how far a person will go for revenge.

movies.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
movies.overview: Bart Millard, lead singer of MercyMe, faces a personal crisis at the peak of his success. As his world unravels, he struggles with his beliefs and inner demons while seeking a path through adversity.

movies.title: The Dresden Sun
movies.overview: A mercenary's heist of "the sphere" from Peredor Corp goes wrong. C and Earth Corp chase otherworldly tech for a science project. A financial analyst flees deadly rivals amid corporate espionage.

movies.title: Scream 7
movies.overview: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

movies.title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
movies.overview: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

movies.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
movies.overview: The definitive account of Japan's struggle as it faced a nuclear catastrophe while still reeling from the devastation of an earthquake and tsunami.

movies.title: Shakira: Live from Paris
movies.overview: This musical release from pop singer Shakira captures a live performance by the artist, recorded live in Paris. Some of the songs featured in the performance include "Nothing Else Matters", "Whenever, Wherever", "Underneath Your Clothes", "Why Wait", and more.

movies.title: Never Back Down: No Surrender
movies.overview: Picking up after the events of Never Back Down 2, former MMA champion Case Walker is on the comeback trail to become champion once again.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.overview: After their grandmother passes away, a family tries to outrun the sinister fate they've inherited.

movies.title: The Carpenter's Son
movies.overview: Family hiding in Roman Egypt. Son known as 'the Boy' doubts guardian 'the Carpenter', rebelling with mysterious powers. As he uses abilities, they face natural and divine horrors.
movies.overviewEs: En una aldea en las remotas fronteras del Imperio Romano, un niño bajo la protección de un carpintero comienza a cuestionar la autoridad de su guardián. Su curiosidad y su búsqueda por desentrañar los secretos de su familia despertarán fuerzas sobrenaturales que trascienden la comprensión.

movies.title: No Other Choice
movies.overview: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

movies.title: The Beach
movies.overview: Garland's novel centers on a young nicotine-addicted traveler named Richard, an avid pop-culture buff with a particular love for video games and Vietnam War movies. While at a hotel in Bangkok, he finds a map left by his strange, whacked-out neighbor, who just committed suicide. The map supposedly leads to a legendary island paradise where some other wayward souls have settled.
movies.overviewEs: Impulsado por el deseo de vivir experiencias y emociones apasionantes, Richard (Leonardo DiCaprio), un joven mochilero, va a Thailandia. En Bangkok, se aloja en un hotel de mala muerte, donde conoce a una pareja de franceses, Étienne (Guillaume Canet) y Françoise (Virginie Ledoyen), y a Daffy (Robert Carlyle), un viajero consumido por años de sol y drogas y que está de vuelta de todo. Daffy, un ser tortuoso y paranoico, le cuenta a Richard una historia fantástica sobre una isla paradisíaca que nunca ha sido profanada por los turistas.

movies.title: Predestination
movies.overview: PREDESTINATION chronicles the life of a Temporal Agent sent on an intricate series of time-travel journeys designed to ensure the continuation of his law enforcement career for all eternity. Now, on his final assignment, the Agent must pursue the one criminal that has eluded him throughout time.

movies.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
movies.overview: In 1967 Los Angeles, a widowed mother and her two daughters add a new stunt to bolster their séance scam business and unwittingly invite authentic evil into their home. When the youngest daughter is overtaken by the merciless spirit, this small family confronts unthinkable fears to save her and send her possessor back to the other side.

movies.title: The One
movies.overview: On August 24, 1981, the newlyweds Larisa and Vladimir Savitsky stepped on board the plane, following the flight Komsomolsk-on-Amur - Blagoveshchensk.

movies.title: Regretting You
movies.overview: Morgan Grant and her daughter Clara explore what's left behind after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other.

movies.title: Return to Silent Hill
movies.overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill--a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

movies.title: Shelter
movies.overview: A reclusive former government assassin finds his forced isolation shattered when a stranded supply girl triggers a lethal tracking system, forcing him to defend her against his old handler's relentless execution squads.

movies.title: The Shadow's Edge
movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

movies.title: Hamnet
movies.overview: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

movies.title: Marty Supreme
movies.overview: Marty Mauser (Timothée Chalamet), a wily hustler with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness in this globe-spanning, full-throttle thrill ride from Josh Safdie (Uncut Gems).

movies.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movies.overview: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.
movies.overviewEs: El Dr. Kelson se encuentra en una nueva relación impactante, con consecuencias que podrían cambiar el mundo tal como lo conocen, y el encuentro de Spike con Jimmy Crystal se convierte en una pesadilla de la que no puede escapar.

movies.title: I Saw the Devil
movies.overview: Kyung-chul is a dangerous psychopath who kills for pleasure. Soo-hyeon, a top-secret agent, decides to track down the murderer himself. He promises himself that he will do everything in his power to take vengeance against the killer, even if it means that he must become a monster himself.

movies.title: Rental Family
movies.overview: An American actor in Tokyo struggling to find purpose lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese "rental family" agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. He rediscovers purpose, belonging, and the beauty of human connection.

movies.title: The Wrecking Crew
movies.overview: Estranged half brothers Jonny, a volatile suspended cop, and James, a disciplined Navy SEAL, reluctantly reunite in Hawaii after their private investigator father is murdered, triggering a dangerous clash with Yakuza operatives.

movies.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
movies.overview: After witnessing his parents' brutal murder on Christmas Eve, Billy transforms into a Killer Santa, delivering a yearly spree of calculated, chilling violence. This year, his blood-soaked mission collides with love, as a young woman challenges him to confront his darkness.

movies.title: Anaconda
movies.overview: A group of friends facing mid-life crises head to the rainforest with the intention of remaking their favorite movie from their youth, only to find themselves in a fight for their lives against natural disasters, giant snakes and violent criminals.
movies.overviewEs: Doug y Griff, amigos de toda la vida, atraviesan una crisis de mediana edad y deciden realizar el remake de su película favorita de su juventud: Anaconda (1997). Viajan a la selva amazónica para filmar su versión, pero pronto descubren que una anaconda real los acecha, convirtiendo su proyecto cinematográfico en una lucha por sobrevivir. La película combina comedia, acción y terror en una experiencia cinematográfica única.

movies.title: Greenland 2: Migration
movies.overview: Greenland sequel. In a continuation of the story, the Garrity family, who survive a near-extinction level event when an interstellar comet hits Earth, must leave the safety of the Greenland bunker and embark on a perilous journey across the decimated frozen wasteland of Europe to find a new home.

movies.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
movies.overview: Young sweethearts Billy and Kate move to the Big Apple, land jobs in a high-tech office park and soon reunite with the friendly and lovable Gizmo. But a series of accidents creates a whole new generation of Gremlins. The situation worsens when the devilish green creatures invade a top-secret laboratory and develop genetically altered powers, making them even harder to destroy!

movies.title: Gremlins
movies.overview: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

movies.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
movies.overview: Growing up poor in Madras, India, Srinivasa Ramanujan Iyengar earns admittance to Cambridge University during WWI, where he becomes a pioneer in mathematical theories with the guidance of his professor, G.H. Hardy.

movies.title: Left Behind
movies.overview: "Left Behind" finds commercial airline pilot Ray Steele (Nicholas Cage) struggling to keep his passengers calm and his plane afloat after the Biblical Rapture strikes mid-flight. Meanwhile, GWN reporter Cameron "Buck" Williams (Chad Michael Murray) becomes Ray's reluctant co-pilot, and Ray's terrified daughter Chloe (Cassi Thomson) braves the chaos of the city streets in search of her brother and mother.

movies.title: Predator: Badlands
movies.overview: In the future, on a remote planet, Dek, a young predator recently outcast from his native clan, finds an unlikely ally in Thia. Together, they soon embark on a treacherous and extremely dangerous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.overview: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.
movies.overviewEs: Devastados por la guerra contra la RDA y la perdida de su hijo mayor, Jake Sully y Neytiri se enfrentan a una nueva amenaza en Pandora: el pueblo de la ceniza, una violenta tribu Na'vi ávida de poder liderada por los despiadados Varang.

movies.title: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
movies.overview: A young Aztec boy experiences tragedy when his father is murdered by Spanish Conquistadors. Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlan to warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger.
movies.overviewEs: En la época del Imperio Azteca, Yohualli Coatl, un joven azteca, experimenta una tragedia cuando su padre y líder de la aldea, Toltecatzin, es asesinado por los conquistadores españoles. Yohualli escapa a Tenochtitlán para advertir al rey Moctezuma y a su sumo sacerdote, Yoka, del peligro inminente. Usando el templo de Tzinacan, el dios murciélago, como guarida, Yohualli entrena con su mentor y asistente, Acatzin, desarrollando equipo y armamento para enfrentar la invasión española, proteger el templo de Moctezuma y vengar la muerte de su padre.

movies.title: Zootopia 2
movies.overview: After cracking the biggest case in Zootopia's history, rookie cops Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde find themselves on the twisting trail of a great mystery when Gary De'Snake arrives and turns the animal metropolis upside down. To crack the case, Judy and Nick must go undercover to unexpected new parts of town, where their growing partnership is tested like never before.

movies.title: Nuremberg
movies.overview: 1945. WW2 is over and several Nazi leaders, including Hitler's Number 2 Hermann Goering, have been captured by the Allies. The American aim is to try the leaders in an international court but that is proving difficult to arrange. Meanwhile, Dr Douglas Kelley, a psychiatrist in the US Army, is assigned to evaluate the mental state of the prisoners, in the process getting close to Goering. This is his story.

movies.title: Eternity
movies.overview: In an afterlife where souls decide where they'll spend eternity, Joan (Elizabeth Olsen) must choose between the man she spent her life with (Miles Teller) and her first love (Callum Turner), who has waited decades for her.
movies.overviewEs: En un más allá donde las almas tienen una semana para decidir dónde pasarán la eternidad, Joan (Elizabeth Olsen) se enfrenta a la diabólica disyuntiva de elegir entre el hombre con el que ha compartido su vida (Miles Teller) y su primer amor (Callum Turner), que murió joven y ha estado décadas esperando a que ella llegara.

movies.title: Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere
movies.overview: Bruce Springsteen's journey crafting his 1982 album Nebraska, which emerged as he recorded Born in the USA with the E Street Band. Based on Warren Zanes' book.

movies.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
movies.overview: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Abby runs away to reconnect with her animatronic friends, uncovering dark secrets about the true origins of Freddy's and unleashing a horror hidden for decades.
movies.overviewEs: Un año después de los sucesos de Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, y con la llegada de un nuevo Faszfest al pueblo. Abby se escapa para reencontrarse con Freddy, Bonnie, Chica y Foxy con oscuros secretos revelándose.

movies.title: Influencers
movies.overview: In Southern France, a young woman's chilling fascination with murder and identity theft sends her life into a whirlwind of chaos.

movies.title: It Ends
movies.overview: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

movies.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
movies.overview: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.

movies.title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
movies.originalTitle: 劇場版 チェンソーマン レゼ篇
movies.overview: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?
movies.overviewEs: En una brutal guerra entre demonios, cazadores y enemigos secretos, una misteriosa chica llamada Reze ha entrado en el mundo de Denji, y él enfrenta su batalla más mortal hasta ahora, impulsado por el amor en un mundo donde la supervivencia no conoce reglas.

movies.title: The Running Man
movies.overview: A desperate contestant enters a globally broadcast death game where hired killers track participants across international borders. Cameras document every chase, every near miss, every kill. Audiences vote, sponsors intervene, and survival becomes performance art. The hunted runs while the world watches, entertains itself, and waits for the inevitable collapse of flesh against choreography.

movies.title: Tron: Ares
movies.overview: Get ready for the electrifying action and adventure of "Tron: Ares." When a highly sophisticated Program named Ares is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission, it marks humankind's first encounter with A.I. beings.

movies.title: Dangerous Animals
movies.overview: When Zephyr, a savvy and free-spirited surfer, is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer and held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.
movies.overviewEs: Zephyr, una surfista inteligente y de espíritu libre, que es secuestrada por un asesino en serie obsesionado con los tiburones. Cautiva en su barco, debe averiguar cómo escapar antes de que él lleve a cabo un ritual de alimentación a los tiburones.

movies.title: Revenge of the Nerds
movies.overview: At Adams College, the jocks rule from their house on high, the Alpha Beta fraternity. So when a group of socially-challenged misfits try to go Greek, they're instantly rejected by every house on campus. Deciding to start their own frat to protect their outcast brothers, the nerds soon find themselves in a battle royale as the Alpha Betas try to crush their new rivals.

movies.title: Dangal
movies.overview: Biopic of Mahavir Singh Phogat, who taught wrestling to his daughters Babita Kumari and Geeta Phogat. Geeta Phogat was India's first female wrestler to win at the 2010 Commonwealth Games, where she won the gold medal (55 kg) while her sister Babita Kumari won the silver (51 kg).
movies.overviewEs: Dangal es una historia verdadera extraordinaria basada en la vida de Mahavir Singh y sus dos hijas, Geeta y Babita Phogat. La película traza el viaje inspirador de un padre que entrena a sus hijas para convertirse en luchadores de clase mundial.

movies.title: Margin Call
movies.overview: Set in the high-stakes world of the financial industry, involving the key players at an investment firm during one perilous 24-hour period in the early stages of the 2008 financial crisis. An entry-level analyst unlocks information that could prove to be the downfall of the firm.

movies.title: Altered
movies.overview: In an alternate present, genetically enhanced humans dominate society. Outcasts Leon and Chloe fight for justice against corrupt politicians exploiting genetic disparity, risking everything to challenge the oppressive system.

movies.title: Train Dreams
movies.overview: A logger leads a life of unexpected depth and beauty in the rapidly-changing America of the early 1900s.

movies.title: Clue
movies.overview: Clue finds six colorful dinner guests gathered at the mansion of their host, Mr. Boddy -- who turns up dead after his secret is exposed: He was blackmailing all of them. With the killer among them, the guests and Boddy's chatty butler must suss out the culprit before the body count rises.
movies.overviewEs: Un heterogéneo grupo de personas se reúne a cenar en una lujosa mansión y uno de los asistentes aparece muerto durante la velada. Ahora, deben averiguar quién de ellos ha sido el culpable. Una tarea complicada teniendo en cuenta que todos ellos tenían motivos suficientes para cometer el crimen. Película basada en el célebre juego de mesa "¿Quién es el culpable?

movies.title: American Made
movies.overview: Barry Seal was just an ordinary pilot who worked for TWA before he was recruited by the CIA in 1978. His work in South America eventually caught the eye of the Medellín Cartel, associated with Pablo Escobar, who needed a man with his skill set. Barry became a drug trafficker, gun smuggler and money launderer. Soon acquiring the title, 'The gringo that always delivers'.
movies.overviewEs: Década de 1980. Después de haber trabajado como piloto de TWA, la mayor aerolínea estadounidense, Barry Seal se convierte en narcotraficante, y posteriormente es reclutado por la CIA para realizar labores de inteligencia. La película cuenta la historia de este ex piloto que se puso al cargo de una de las más importantes operaciones encubiertas de la CIA en la historia de los Estados Unidos. Esta hazaña, con la que se logró apresar a varios miembros del cartel de Medellín, estuvo cerca de provocar la caída del gobierno de la Casa Blanca durante la presidencia de Ronald Reagan, a causa del escándalo Irangate.

movies.title: The Edge
movies.overview: A model has her rich, much older husband come with her to a photo shoot. But when their plane crashes in the middle of nowhere, a strong mind game erupts between the clever husband and the jealous young photographer as they try to get back to civilization.
movies.overviewEs: Un multimillonario intelectual y otros dos hombres luchan por unirse y sobrevivir después de quedar varados en el desierto de Alaska con un oso Kodiak hambriento que los persigue.

movies.title: Into the Deep
movies.overview: Pirates on the hunt for sunken drugs kidnap a boat of tourists and force them to dive into shark infested waters to retrieve the contraband.

movies.title: The Big Short
movies.overview: Prior to the 2008 financial crisis, a group of investors bet against the US mortgage market and are stunned by the corruption they uncover through their research.
movies.overviewEs: Basado en la historia real de cuatro audaces inversores que vieron lo que los grandes bancos, los medios y el gobierno se negaron a ver: el inminente colapso de la economía mundial que resultó en la crisis financiera de 2008.

movies.title: The Running Man
movies.overview: In a future dystopian America, a wrongfully accused and convicted policeman gets his shot at freedom when he's forced to participate in a TV game show where convicts called Runners must battle killers for their freedom.

movies.title: The First Purge
movies.overview: America's third political party, the New Founding Fathers of America, comes to power and conducts an experiment: no laws for 12 hours on Staten Island. No one has to stay on the island, but $5,000 is given to anyone who does.
movies.overviewEs: Los Nuevos Padres Fundadores de América quieren reducir las tasas de criminalidad, por lo que deciden poner a prueba a los ciudadanos de una pequeña región del país mediante un experimento social, dando vía libre a todo tipo de crímenes durante una noche. Sin embargo, la fuerza de estos actos violentos aumenta hasta que acaba traspasando las fronteras establecidas.

movies.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
movies.overview: Johnny Blaze, a man who made a deal with the Devil who called himself Mephistopheles at the time (now Roarke), is on the run trying to make sure no-one is harmed by his alter ego, The Ghost Rider. He is approached by a Monk named Moreau who tells him that he can help be him free of the Rider, but first, he needs Johnny's help to protect a boy, whom Roarke has plans for, to help him take human form.

movies.title: Ghost Rider
movies.overview: In order to save his dying father, young stunt cyclist Johnny Blaze sells his soul to Mephistopheles and sadly parts from the pure-hearted Roxanne Simpson, the love of his life. Years later, Johnny's path crosses again with Roxanne, now a go-getting reporter, and also with Mephistopheles, who offers to release Johnny's soul if Johnny becomes the fabled, fiery 'Ghost Rider'.

movies.title: The Frighteners
movies.overview: After a tragic car accident that kills his wife, a man discovers he can communicate with the dead, and he uses that gift to con people. However, when a demonic spirit appears, he may be the only one who can stop it from killing the living and the dead.

movies.title: One Battle After Another
movies.overview: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.

movies.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
movies.overview: Valentín, a political prisoner, shares a cell with Molina, a window dresser convicted of public indecency. The two form an unlikely bond as Molina recounts the plot of a Hollywood musical starring his favorite silver screen diva, Ingrid Luna.

movies.title: Little Fockers
movies.overview: It has taken 10 years, two little Fockers with wife Pam and countless hurdles for Greg to finally get in with his tightly wound father-in-law, Jack. After the cash-strapped dad takes a job moonlighting for a drug company, Jack's suspicions about his favorite male nurse come roaring back. When Greg and Pam's entire clan descends for the twins' birthday party, Greg must prove to the skeptical Jack that he's fully capable as the man of the house.

movies.title: The Ballad of Buster Scruggs
movies.overview: Vignettes weaving together the stories of six individuals in the old West at the end of the Civil War. Following the tales of a sharp-shooting songster, a wannabe bank robber, two weary traveling performers, a lone gold prospector, a woman traveling the West to an uncertain future, and a motley crew of strangers undertaking a carriage ride.
movies.overviewEs: Una película de antología compuesta por seis historias, cada una de ellas sobre un aspecto diferente de la vida en el Viejo Oeste.  Seis caminos que tejen las historias en el viejo Oeste al final de la Guerra Civil. Siguiendo los relatos de un cantor de filo, un aspirante a ladrón de bancos, dos artistas que viajan cansados, un buscador de oro solitario, una mujer que viaja a Occidente hacia un futuro incierto, y un equipo variopinto de extraños que realizan un viaje en carruaje.

movies.title: Good Fortune
movies.overview: A well-meaning but rather inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy venture capitalist.

movies.title: Cronos
movies.overview: A mysterious device designed to provide its owner with eternal life resurfaces after four hundred years, leaving a trail of destruction in its path.
movies.overviewEs: El anticuario Jesús Gris encuentra por casualidad un extraño aparato dorado, parecido a un escarabajo, que permaneció oculto durante varios siglos. Se trata de la "Invención de Cronos", una pieza milenaria capaz de dar vida eterna a quien la posea.

movies.title: Meet the Fockers
movies.overview: Hard-to-crack ex-CIA man Jack Byrnes and his wife Dina head for the warmer climes of Florida to meet the parents of their son-in-law-to-be, Greg Focker. Unlike their happily matched offspring, the future in-laws find themselves in a situation of opposites that definitely do not attract.

movies.title: Meet the Parents
movies.overview: Greg Focker is ready to marry his girlfriend, Pam, but before he pops the question, he must win over her formidable father, humorless former CIA agent Jack Byrnes, at the wedding of Pam's sister. As Greg bends over backward to make a good impression, his visit to the Byrnes home turns into a hilarious series of disasters, and everything that can go wrong does, all under Jack's critical, hawklike gaze.

movies.title: Frankenstein
movies.overview: Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro adapts Mary Shelley's classic tale of Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist who brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.
